content:
katie: quick check — proposing compact ingest contract for sidecar -> append-only ledger migration. RFC: https://rfc.internal/compact-ledger-sidecar. any blockers?

ashish: main risk is replay idempotency. need stable claim id (not just ts) so reconciler can dedupe.

liam: can we emit lease_id+expiry as short pre-claim to avoid duplicate in-flight claims? cheaper than full canonicalization.

maya: audit needs provenance_ref for every claim (pointer to original request/event guid) otherwise backfills can't be tied.

charlie: for cross-region failover, leases alone can double-credit. prefer append-only ledger + dedupe in reconciliation. sidecar can fast-path hint.

ashish: compromise: append-only ingest, sidecar adds short_fingerprint and claim_hint. reconciler uses full fingerprint+provenance_ref for final decision.

katie: minimal contract sketch:
{"event_id":"uuid","tenant_id":"str","source":"api|grpc|backfill","tokens":"int","fingerprint":"hex","short_fingerprint":"hex8","provenance_ref":"str","lease_id":"opt","claimed_at":"iso-ts","handshake_version":"v2"}

ingest-bot: contract validator: v2 -> 78% pass; failures mostly missing provenance_ref in backfills.

liam: rollout: canary tenants 48h with dual-write (old+new). monitor duplicate_claim_rate & reconcile_deltas. keep backfill verify-only for 7d.

maya: add two error codes: duplicate_claim and stale_provenance. i'll update schema registry & docs.

ashish: reconciler rules: if event_id matches -> idempotent ack. if event_id differs but fingerprint+provenance match -> route to audit queue.

charlie: include origin_region field so reconciler can apply region precedence during lag.

katie: actions: ashish -> dedupe prototype, liam -> canary plan+dashboards, maya -> schema updates, charlie -> region precedence doc. follow-up thursday 30m. :thumbsup:

liam: will post checklist by EOD tomorrow.

katie: thanks all.
